items.title: 玩家成长聚合并发覆盖：不同主题合法通关丢累计里程/节点数

basis.fact: Real exploration redemption entry invokes redeemExploreChapterAndRecord.

Transactional exploration redemption locks its own activity and registration, not a shared player growth row; :3077 calls topicCompletionAwardService.grantOnce after genuine required-chapter completion.

First completion invokes playerProgressionService.onTopicComplete before event-13 points awarding. Different topics claim different TOPIC_FINISH badges, so that unique key does not serialize this player aggregate.
ensureGrowth uses ordinary selectByMember; onTopicComplete :143-147 computes a new absolute mileage in Java, then updates the aggregate.
updatePlayerGrowth overwrites every non-null aggregate field under only WHERE member_id; no version predicate or atomic increment. selectByMember :17 is an ordinary cached read.
A second real writer calls onNodeDone; onNodeDone :121 also writes the full aggregate from an ordinary read, allowing unrelated mileage/checkin fields to overwrite one another.

trigger.preconditions: Existing player_growth row; same player completes two distinct topics through distinct activity/registration redemptions in concurrent valid requests. Choose merchants with no active referral relationship to that player so unrelated referral activation cannot incidentally lock this player. No new API/authentication policy is required.
interleaving: A and B claim different topic completion badge keys and both ordinary-read total_mileage=0.
A computes topic X mileage 10; B computes topic Y mileage 20.
A UPDATE writes 10 and holds the growth-row write lock until commit. B waits at its UPDATE, then writes its stale absolute 20 after A commits.

Both real first-completion badges remain, but mileage is 20 instead of 30. Existing transaction boundaries do not make the earlier ordinary read current. Whole-row payload can also revert total_checkins when a node-completion writer overlaps.
counterprotections_checked: Topic-specific badge unique keys do not conflict across X and Y.
Per-activity/per-registration locks differ across the two valid requests.
Node event-12 points can lock a member on some classic routes; this is not a universal guard, and the explored redemption route reaches progression before event-13 points.
No other PlayerGrowthMapper insert/update writer was found outside PlayerProgressionServiceImpl in current production Java.

items.implementation_contract: Inside PlayerProgressionServiceImpl and PlayerGrowthMapper Java/XML, make growth mutation a single transaction with real current member-growth row read (cache disabled/flushed) before computing and persisting the aggregate; handle existing unique member initialization without DDL. Keep all growth writers on that same current-read protocol, including onNodeDone and onTopicComplete, and retain existing first-completion/badge guards. An atomic delta plus authoritative readback is an alternative only if unchanged level/streak/threshold semantics are preserved. No caller/source-owned controller needs editing.
items.acceptance: Different-topic legitimate completion mileage10+20 must retain30; crossing onNodeDone/onTopicComplete cannot overwrite independent fields; initialization and same-topic idempotency preserved; existing level/streak/threshold/date semantics unchanged. Source-only regression, actual database validation local.
